regions.name: Northern & central unimodal areas
regions.where: Savanes, Kara and Centrale: the northern two-thirds of the country (purple on the top locator map)

planting.name: Maize, sorghum, millet, cotton: land prep, planting, weeding (one bar)

regions.notes: Rainy shading ends mid-Oct. Maize/sorghum/millet/cotton harvest drawn as Jan + Oct-Dec pieces, merged. Planting bars combine land prep, planting and weeding (maize etc. May to mid-Aug; yam Mar to mid-May).

regions.name: Southern bimodal areas
regions.where: Plateaux and Maritime: the southern third of the country (purple on the bottom locator map)

harvest.name: Palm oil, cassava and vegetables harvest (year-round)

planting.name: Maize S1: prep, planting, weeding (one bar)

regions.notes: Rainy Season 1 Mar to mid-Jul, Rainy Season 2 Sep to mid-Nov; lean Apr to mid-Jun. Maize S1 harvest mid-Jun to Aug (after a May to mid-Jun green harvest, skipped). Coffee/cocoa drawn as Jan-Feb + Sep-Dec, merged. Rice prep bars skipped.

assign.method: Locator maps split the country along the Centrale/Plateaux boundary (about 8 N); regions assigned by that line.

transcriber_notes: 2024+ template: element edges sit on a half-month grid; a month that is exactly half covered counts (>= half rule). Half months counted: north rainy Oct, maize planting Aug, yam planting May; south rainy Jul & Nov, lean Jun, maize S1 harvest Jun, lowland rice planting Jul, highland rice planting Jul. Rice links are by timing and uncertain: lowland rice (planted May-Jul, harvested Oct-Nov) linked to Rainy Season 1; highland rice (planted mid-Jul-Aug, harvested Nov-Dec) linked to Rainy Season 2.
